jobs.name: X feed catch-up
jobs.prompt: Do a catch-up pass: snoopy_alerts first, then snoopy_status and snoopy_wallets, then page snoopy_feed until caught up, then snoopy_positions. Give each new post a one-line verdict (LAUNCH | BUY | SKIP | SELL — what — why) and act per your standing orders: draft launches for LAUNCH posts, never confirm or trade without owner approval. Report at most five lines.
